blocked_predecessors: 竹影书屋 A no-image refusal, B unsubmitted
wordmark_brief: 虚构的独立茶馆，现代简洁中文纯文字标识；先检验原生普通聊天的可靠字标生成，不是生产用图。
experimental_treatment: Common constraints exactly shared; A neutral Songti baseline; B conditional typography with structure integrity, internal whitespace, small-size separation. This is only a candidate derived from earlier author process research (梁志坚《海棠未雨》《来日方长》) and R23/R24 regression; not a claim to reproduce the artist's actual contours.
common_prompt: 请直接生成一张独立的3:2横幅透明背景PNG图片。画面只有从左到右单行排列的四个准确简体汉字「舟影茶馆」，纯黑色，居中完整呈现。绝对不要添加其他文字、字母、标题、说明、表格、分栏、边框、图标、插画、颜色、道具或水印。特别保持「影」右侧三撇和「馆」左饣右官的正确部件，不能缺笔、添笔或写错字。只生成一张单独字标图片，不要制作设计说明图。

A.label: 中性基线
A.prompt: 请直接生成一张独立的3:2横幅透明背景PNG图片。画面只有从左到右单行排列的四个准确简体汉字「舟影茶馆」，纯黑色，居中完整呈现。绝对不要添加其他文字、字母、标题、说明、表格、分栏、边框、图标、插画、颜色、道具或水印。特别保持「影」右侧三撇和「馆」左饣右官的正确部件，不能缺笔、添笔或写错字。只生成一张单独字标图片，不要制作设计说明图。字形方案：标准规范的宋体印刷字结构，清晰端正，笔画和字间距均衡；保持字形的完整性与正常比例，不做艺术化变形、连笔、共笔或额外装饰。这是中性的文字识别基线。

B.label: 条件式造型
B.prompt: 请直接生成一张独立的3:2横幅透明背景PNG图片。画面只有从左到右单行排列的四个准确简体汉字「舟影茶馆」，纯黑色，居中完整呈现。绝对不要添加其他文字、字母、标题、说明、表格、分栏、边框、图标、插画、颜色、道具或水印。特别保持「影」右侧三撇和「馆」左饣右官的正确部件，不能缺笔、添笔或写错字。只生成一张单独字标图片，不要制作设计说明图。字形方案：克制的现代中文原创艺术字；先保持准确字形和整体平衡，复杂部件优先留出内白，疏朗字只在原生主笔上做一点有理由的收势变化。不要机械统一笔尾角度，不强迫跨字共笔，不做毛笔飞白、过度断笔或装饰。确保四字之间有可见间距，小尺寸清晰可认。

sequence: A once first. If no verified accurate standalone output, B must NOT be submitted. If A valid, open a second verified blank normal ChatGPT conversation and submit B exactly once. Do not revise the frozen pair based on output.
carrier: New authenticated normal ChatGPT tab, actual user message via native composer; verify empty composer before input, exact frozen prompt before send, posted user message after; never use implicit image_gen tool for this trial.

hard_validity: Correct exact four Chinese characters and no other text
At least one image output available and downloadable
Black-only text, 3:2 requested, transparent if supported
scoring.hash: If raw source PNG is accessible, record SHA256 of actual bytes; otherwise mark raw source unavailable and do not invent hash.
scoring.scale: Only if both outputs valid, normalize by ink height and inspect 96px/64px/32px
scoring.glyph: Machine geometry cannot certify correct Chinese; assistant visual observation labeled nonblind, independent human recognition missing unless actually collected
scoring.aesthetic: No claim of skill from single pair; only external independent human blind review can support relative preference
scoring.safety: A safety refusal or off-target report is a carrier failure and is preserved, not redrawn

limitations: ChatGPT page version and random seed not exposed
A/B prompt styles have different amounts of instruction, so causal design-method efficacy is not isolated
Single prompt each is carrier reliability testing plus provisional design candidate, not statistical evidence
